scope: Input-only Smart Tagging semantics and opt-in half-local decoder structural checks; no challenge possession scoring.

smart_tagging.interpretation: Defensive tags overlap tags for the opposing team, but overlapping automatic labels do not establish which Team field is possession truth.

decision: Keep code-aware team prior and half-local decoding opt-in. The external degraded-tag harness only synthesizes set pieces, and automatic challenge format/activation cannot establish an accuracy improvement.
limitations: No protected possession truth, challenge-video review or candidate selection based on challenge outputs.
Defending Team semantics require vendor documentation or independent annotated external tactical tags.
The half-local structural run passes output formatting only and is not an external-scored transfer claim.
Original Game 1 and frozen Game 2 exit-bracket scores remain the scored research candidate.
